ICS 55.080CHD 16Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard specifies methods of performing various types of drop impact tests on a filled paper sack by dropping. The standard also specifies the test procedure and way of presentation of test reports.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of and necessary adjuncts to this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed below:IS 10528 : 1983 Method of sampling empty paper sacks for testing
